name: Brain Freeze
body:
School necromancy [mind-affecting, pain]; Level cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M/DF (an icicle)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one living creature

Duration 1 round

Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

This spell causes fleeting yet intense pain in the subject’s brain triggered by a false sensory response to extreme cold. On a failed save, the subject takes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +5), and is staggered and distracted. Although this spell deals no cold damage, creatures immune to cold damage are also immune to this spell.
